title: Multimodal MRI in Multiple Sclerosis (MS): Reliability and Follow Up
brief_summary: To determine wether multimodal MRI (conventinal T1 and T2 sequences, diffusion, magnetization transfer, spectroscopy) is reproducible; to follow up a cohort of patients with early remmittent MS after treatment with interferon.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* MS patients according to Poser's criteria
* Remitting evolution (less than two years of evolution)
* Aged 18-50
* Immunomodulatory treatment indicated

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to perform MRI
